# Refraction angle

```r
refracAng(theta1, v1, v2)
```

## Arguments

- `theta1`: Incidence angle (media 1)
- `v1`: Electromagnetic wave velocity of media 1
- `v2`: Electromagnetic wave velocity of media 2

## Description

Compute the refraction angle based on the incidence angle and the refractive indices of the two media (applies Snell's Law, also known as the law of refraction)
